name: Material Things
overview: Scripture warns believers against placing their trust and affection in material possessions, emphasizing that earthly treasures are temporary and vulnerable to decay and theft. True integrity and righteousness are valued above wealth, as seen in the contrast between the poor who walk in integrity and the fool with perverse lips. Jesus teaches that one cannot serve both God and material wealth, urging followers to prioritize God's kingdom and righteousness, with the assurance that their material needs will be met. Believers are also cautioned to practice their giving discreetly, seeking the reward of the Father rather than human approval.
